name: CBF Late Cutoff
description: Fork of Click Between Frames 1.5.0 with the old "Late Input Cutoff" option brought back (experimental). Do not enable together with the original CBF.

soft-toggle.name: Disable CBF
soft-toggle.description: Disable CBF/CoS without needing to restart GD. This option does not disable physics bypass if you have it enabled!

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Disable progress & stats on rated levels.

click-on-steps.name: Click on Steps
click-on-steps.description: Only register inputs with 240TPS precision. Should have identical physics to vanilla.

mouse-fix.name: Reduce Mouse Lag
mouse-fix.description:
Reduce lag when using high polling rate mice.
Experimental, may break things.

precision-fix.name: Precision Fix
precision-fix.description:
Improve input precision by preventing framerate desync.
Experimental, may break things.

late-cutoff.name: Late Input Cutoff
late-cutoff.description:
Check for inputs right before physics instead of at the start of the frame.

Slightly reduces input lag, but may slightly hurt precision. Experimental.

late-cutoff-keys.name: Late Cutoff: Keyboard
late-cutoff-keys.description: Also apply Late Input Cutoff to keyboard jump/move keys (Space, W, Up, A, D, Left, Right). Mouse click is always included.

physics-bypass.name: Enable Physics Bypass
physics-bypass.description:
Reduces stuttering on some FPS values. Active even if "Disable CBF" is checked.

THIS WILL ALTER PHYSICS AND MAY BREAK SOME LEVELS! DON'T USE THIS IF YOUR LIST/LEADERBOARD BANS PHYSICS BYPASS!

bypass-mode.name: Physics Bypass Mode
bypass-mode.description:
2.2 mode means as few collision checks per frame as possible (with a minimum of 240 checks per second).

2.1 mode means 4 collision checks per frame at 60fps or above

wine-workaround.name: Wine Workaround
wine-workaround.description:
Wine doesn't let you get keyboard input between frames, so this is a workaround. However, it may not work properly on some PCs.

Only disable if experiencing issues (and don't play with keyboard if you disable it).

right-click.name: Right Click P2
right-click.description: Use right click for player 2 jump.
